name: flow-sf-file-discovery
description: SF -> LCC: File Discovery (PA-collector, W3.7c). Weekly scheduled flow that discovers Salesforce Files attached to staged Comp/Listing/Deal records and lands them in Supabase sf_files, then moves the bytes. Replaces the retired server-side Connected-App sweep (the org is SSO-gated, no Connected App). Power Automate is transport only; all dedup/routing/storage/extraction happen on the LCC edge side. See docs/flows/FLOW_sf_file_discovery.md.

trigger.cadence_knob: Recurrence interval — weekly default; the file corpus changes slowly.

FN_BASE.note: intake-salesforce-files is deployed on Dialysis_DB and reaches both gov+dia via env vars — one base URL covers both domains.

LCC_PA_WEBHOOK_SECRET.note: Equals the edge function PA_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Sent on every HTTP action as header X-PA-Webhook-Secret.

SALESFORCE_CONNECTION.note: One interactively-authenticated (SSO) Salesforce connection, reused by every SF action. The only manual maintenance surface.

WORKLIST_LIMIT.note: Ids fetched per run (edge caps 1000, split across domains).

STALE_DAYS.note: Re-attempt window — a served id is leased this long.

steps.name: HTTP_GetWorklist
steps.note: Returns staged Comp/Listing/Deal ids (BOTH domains) with no sf_files row and no attempt in STALE_DAYS. Stamps each served id (lease).

actions.name: SF_GetContentDocumentLinks
actions.note: ContentDocumentLink requires a bounded LinkedEntityId filter.

steps.name: HTTP_DiscoverWebhook
steps.batching: Slice DiscoveredFiles into batches of 200 (Do-until with take()/skip()) — one POST per slice.
steps.note: Edge maps each file -> sf_files 'discovered' row, dedup on content_version_id, routes by item.vertical. Returns discovered/skipped_existing/skipped_invalid.

steps.name: ForEach_NewFile_MoveBytes
steps.note: For each newly-discovered file: read VersionData bytes and POST them to file-content. (Skip ids the discover-webhook reported as skipped_existing.)

actions.name: SF_GetVersionData
actions.note: Or use the Salesforce 'Get file content' connector action.

actions.name: HTTP_FileContent
actions.runAfterPolicy: Configure run after Succeeded/Failed; append failures to a Failures array (never abort the batch).
actions.note: Edge verifies sha256 (mismatch->422) + 15MB cap (over->413; use ?action=upload-url for large files), stores bytes, flips row to stored/queued. Idempotent on content_version_id.

extraction: Automatic — the existing sf-files-extract-queued-hourly cron drains extraction_status='queued' via ?action=stage-queued -> /api/intake/stage-om. No PA action.

retired_actions.note: ?action=discover and ?action=fetch (server-side Connected-App sweep) return HTTP 410. The org cannot provision a Connected App; do NOT use SF_CLIENT_ID/SF_CLIENT_SECRET. Salesforce access is PA-only.
